Detailed Description

template<UnaryOpFunction op>
class UnaryOpUGenT< op >

A unary operator UGen using a template for the processing function.

Any function which has the appropriate declaration can be uses as the template parameter. E.g., 

  float myfunc(float a)
  {
    return -a; // return the negative if the input
  }
Template Parameters:
opThis must be the name of a function that takes a float argument and returns a float.
